note: Complete snapshot of the pinned iOS cloud-runtime package, excluding Roost authoring source and its generator. SHA256.json records every mirrored file. Earlier entries retain the source-update history.

roostHistory.note: The iOS asset build verifies the Roost browser module against the pinned source and shared input refactor. Android snapshots the generated module and licenses verbatim. The authoring source and generator stay in iOS.

tabSessionQuota.note: Tabs pass the billing entitlement to createSession, so the free-plan 200-session quota applies to new Tabs as on Web. Mirrored verbatim from the iOS runtime source in the same change.

stableMetaReplica.note: The meta watcher keeps the replica object while its Flock is unchanged, so in-flight writes (Agent Role saves) no longer read a routine poll as a workspace change. Mirrored verbatim from the iOS runtime source in the same change.

catalogReadRecovery.note: Catalog transport/auth failures and Android read suspension retry from the last imported offset and cursor while retaining the verified replica. Protocol, cursor and import failures keep bootstrap recovery. Mirrored verbatim from the iOS runtime source in the same change. Explicit Android host suspension keeps an otherwise valid grant; real transport failures still invalidate it.

failedLatestTurn.note: The catalog projection carries session meta lastHandledUserMsgId and lastFailedUserMsgId, so native lists show a conversation whose latest turn failed. Mirrored verbatim from the iOS runtime source in the same change.

roleMachineNames.note: A Role on several machines labels each @ mention target by its alias or the computer's catalog name instead of the raw machine id. Mirrored verbatim from the iOS runtime source in the same change.

roleMentionAfterText.note: An @session:/@role: chip written straight after non-ASCII text (`让@role:<id>`) expands to its reference at send, so the transcript shows the Role's name instead of the legacy `Role` fallback. Mirrored verbatim from the iOS runtime source in the same change.

perModelConfigOptions.note: Creation options read desktop's per-model option records (acpModelConfigOptions pointers and their shared acpModelConfigOptionsShape lists) for effort and Fast after declarations and modelReasoningEfforts. agentProviderProbe accepts readModelOptions, forwards it only to machines advertising acpModelOptionsRead, and emits agentProviderRefreshProgress for each model it reads.

planExitPlanText.note: The tool_call summary of a plan-approval card (ACP kind switch_mode) carries its plan text as `plan`, resolved like web resolvePlanExitMarkdown: rawInput.plan first, then the first content text block. Only this hunk is mirrored from the iOS runtime source; the file's earlier unmirrored iOS changes (transcript windowing) stay out of the snapshot. The same hunks project a settled request's decision on its permission summary: `chosenOptionId` (outcome selected) or `withdrawn` (outcome cancelled); question answers stay in itemDetail.

workspaceDiffFiles.note: Complete changed-file counts accompany text line totals in session and Project Member catalog projections, including zero-line changes. Mirrored verbatim from the reviewed iOS runtime source commit; dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

historicalDiffUnavailable.note: Historical diff reads retain unavailable results and never substitute the current workspace diff, matching Web. Mirrored verbatim from the reviewed iOS source commit; dependencies, protocol and licenses are unchanged.

scheduleOfflineTargets.note: creationOptions accepts includeOffline for schedule targets: every readable machine's agents, online or not, as on Web; new chats keep online-only agents. The schedules list reads ownedMachineIds and clocks from workspace metadata as well as synced machine streams. Mirrored verbatim from the reviewed iOS source commit; transcript windowing in project.ts and session.ts stays out of the snapshot, and dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

archiveWithoutMachineQueue.note: Archiving no longer writes the machine meta needToArchiveSessions queue, which daemons have discarded since #620 reconciled archived worktrees from session state. Mirrored verbatim from the iOS source in the same change; dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

roostReadiness.note: Mirrors the iOS Roost readiness change. A failed control-stream or owner-history read clears that reader's readiness until it recovers. Unrelated iOS session changes stay outside this snapshot.

scheduleCustomSteps.note: Agent schedule proposals and the editor accept any whole minute or hour step up to 2147483647 (the 32-bit Int the Android rule model carries), as on Web, instead of dropping a proposal card whose step exceeds 59 minutes or 23 hours. A stored interval longer than that reads as unsupported rather than overflowing. Mirrored verbatim from the iOS source in the same change; dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

runtimeSdkUpgrade.note: Full package snapshot from the reviewed iOS dependency upgrade commit. SHA256.json records the exact files. Roost authoring source and its generator remain in iOS. This replaces the earlier selective runtime deltas, including the previously excluded transcript windowing and explicit pending-input reconciliation. iOS pnpm 11 installation, check, test and bundle passed; dependency licenses were regenerated.

catalogRecovery.note: Full-package export after the merged SDK upgrade. Includes per-window budgets, metadata-first publication, safe cost-based snapshot selection, cooperative frame imports, shared machine scans, two initialization slots and 16 ms publication coalescing. The upgraded SDK pins, uploadTimeoutMs: 15000, licenses and remaining canonical source are preserved.

secureWebSocketCsp.note: Mirrors the iOS DataRuntime CSP template: permit wss: alongside https: while retaining all other directives. Dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

roostCheckpointSubscription.note: Shared Roost subscription and exact checkpoint recovery. Scoped history proofs are minted by the native host.

conversationContextUsage.note: Context window usage comes from catalog session meta `contextWindowUsage` (as on web) through sessionQuotaProjection, not the session document, so the composer ring shows context occupancy first. Dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

promptShortcutsUserSpace.note: Prompt Shortcuts migrate to workspace UserSpace streams (`<workspace>:shortcut-index` and `<workspace>:shortcut:<id>`) using the cached workspace Loro Streams token, remove `visibility` (`Share with workspace`) while stripping legacy stored `visibility`, update shortcut body documents in place without rotating `bodyDocId`, and retain Phase 1 read-only fallback to legacy `shortcut-index:*` and `shortcut-body:*` streams. Dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

projectMemberFileRoots.note: File reads and diffs under a Project group member used in place (additional / link) carry that member's rootId and a member-relative path, as web toSessionFileRequestPath does, and reported member keys are shown under the member directory. Dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

contextCompactionStatus.note: Tool call summaries carry the history item's activityKind (context_compaction / codex_retry, web isProcessStatusToolCall), so the transcript can show context compaction as a status row. Dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

diffScope.note: Workspace and file diffs accept the machine's `branch` / `uncommitted` comparison scope and forward it to `open-all-changes-diff` and `open-current-diff`, omitting it when unset so older machines keep their default. Mirrored selectively from the rebased iOS source commit and re-applied on top of the statusView whole-package refresh; the native composer quote additions stay out of this snapshot. Dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

statusView.note: Whole-package refresh at the lody-ios main squash of #130 (same Status view tree as status-view-runtime 467127b4, which main does not contain). Brings the Status view runtime (catalog statusView and pinSections, the five session fields, the live workspace Flock read, the server clock, statusViewCommand / snoozePresets, touchOnSend on dispatch, newSessionOrder on creation, start workspaceReadOnly) with the shared Lody status-view modules and golden vectors vendored under src/protocol/lody-shared at Lody main bffe27262 (LodyAI/Lody#3063 squash-merged; same bytes as status-view-core e542b8729). Since 859f5ac5 only those modules' comments, their provenance and README, and the command vectors (28 cases) changed, plus lody-ios be444c8a message quotes in the shared runtime. Android keeps its own quote adapter in runtime/src; the runtime ignores the quotes it strips. Dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

scheduleMachineKey.note: Arrives with the main pin: scheduleMachine no longer double-prefixes `machine-` before machineMeta, so schedules read the computer's name, owner, clock and protocol support again. Dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

abortSignalAny.note: AbortSignal.any fallback for WebKit before 17.4 and Android System WebView before 116, imported first by the runtime entry. Since platformFallbacks (#136) it only exports and platform-fallbacks.ts installs it; Android documents import that module first. Android adds its own AbortSignal.timeout fallback (runtime/src/abort-signal-timeout.mjs) for WebView 100-102. Dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

statusViewWokenStaysUnread.note: Re-vendored from Lody 6f27d1ba: placing or restoring a woken conversation keeps its expired snooze, so it stays unread until read (11 layout / 33 command vectors).

sessionRouteWait.note: Session readers check in-memory routing metadata every 250 ms and emit waiting updates when the reason changes; network read failures keep exponential backoff. First mirrored by hand in lody-android #30 from the PR head c04277df (same content); recorded at the lody-ios main squash c29b2d66 and reached by the full 9b742013 export.

platformFallbacks.note: One entry, platform-fallbacks.ts, installs the AbortSignal.any and URL.canParse (Chrome 120) fallbacks where missing; the runtime entry imports it first, and abort-signal-any.ts / url-can-parse.ts now only export. Every Android WebView document (runtime/src/{main,debug,network}.mjs) imports platform-fallbacks.ts first, then Android's own AbortSignal.timeout fallback. Dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

statusViewReviewFixes.note: Line C review fixes with the shared modules re-vendored from Lody #3093: the first pin section creates the missing workspace settings stream; a failed append discards and re-bootstraps the replica instead of keeping an unsent commit; touchOnSend reaches Guide/Steer and edit-and-resend sends and resolves a Tab to its conversation; a teammate's local-project conversation is not manageable; canManageSections waits for the section rows; My tasks scopes per conversation and counts the Pinned rows it hid; conversation activity includes its Tabs (unread stays its own); a new clock calibration republishes the catalog so hosts learn the offset from nowMs. No contract shape changes. Dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

steerDeliveryFix.note: Mirrors the reviewed iOS steer delivery fix (#157, plus the existing-turn MCP empty-selection guard in session.ts from #156): avoid writing _lodyDeliveryKind='steer' onto user inputConfig / acpSessionConfig before session/steer confirms applied=true so daemon-requeued steers remain dispatchable; opt out of queue/inbox pausing (pauseInbox=false) when cancelling for interrupt-based steering on operationInbox machines and unpause stopped drafts with a fresh resend id; resolve activeAssistantTurn from only the latest assistant entry; stamp humanInputReceipts on Loro turns; and settle executionProjection delivery states. Dependencies, contract and licenses are unchanged.

sessionConnectionRecovery.note: Mirrors the reviewed iOS session connection recovery fix (#159): probe stream recovery without live long-poll when streamReady is false (and on catalog retries), keep streamReady true across healthy multi-page live bursts, rebase concurrent Roost history supersessions in place, invalidate cached Streams grants on unauthorized/forbidden session reads, and wake pending read-retry sleeps on foreground resume. Dependencies, contract and licenses are unchanged.

pinSectionsWithMeta.note: start opens the workspace settings stream (pin sections) together with :meta instead of after the first catalog publish, so lists no longer show every conversation before their sections and order settle. Only this hunk is mirrored from the reviewed iOS commit; other unmirrored iOS changes stay out of the snapshot, and dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

iosMainSync.note: Full package export at lody-ios main, catching up the unmirrored #141 (session-reported / commands first), #144 (server clock calibration reuse), #147/#149 (reference catalog failures scoped to the affected computer), #151 (promptShortcuts select and listed revision on mention items), #156 (MCP selection keeps an empty persisted selection, settings read retries with grant invalidation, 16 MiB window, synced-replica fallback) and the rest of #162. Dependencies and licenses are unchanged. Android adaptations outside the snapshot: shortcutBody uses select, the send hook expands /shortcut tokens and selects first-turn MCP defaults through a bridge grant request.

roostPermissionReadiness.note: Roost permission answers use command readiness, so they remain available on the installed transcript while the history subscription reconnects. The owner still rejects stale or answered requests. Dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

roostCutoverMainSync.note: Full package export of the Roost cutover after it integrated lody-ios main (which contains the previous iosMainSync commit 9478784). Combines the cutover's owner subscription, scoped history proofs, command readiness and permission readiness with main's quote spans and MCP selection. Dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

scheduleEditProposal.note: Agent schedule edit proposals (web schedule_edit_proposal, LodyAI/Lody#3181): the proposal projection, inspectProposal (live schedule, prompt diff, stale/deleted/owner/machine/Agent reasons) and the applied outcome of decideProposal with the Web per-card activity id. System notice summaries also carry agent_warning source, fork origin and resumed-history meta, and worktree_script items project their phase, status and step output tails. Mirrored verbatim from the iOS source in the same change; dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

createTabHealthGate.note: createSession accepts optional parentSessionId (and CreatedSession carries parentSessionId) so a local draft Tab creates its shared-directory session on first send (copying project, repoFullName, baseBranch and projectRun from the root session). createTab also checks only meta and target machine health. Mirrored verbatim from iOS; dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

resumeTranscriptWindow.note: Mirrors the scoped history start hint on reopen and its authoritative Loro/Roost window reconstruction. Dependencies and licenses are unchanged.

mentionCatchUpReadiness.note: Mirrors the iOS mention expansion and catalog live-update readiness fix: reset the 12 ms frame-import slice after idle reads so single-turn live updates stay synchronous without marking metadata or machines unhealthy, scan and store catalog projections before clearing unhealthy, wait up to 3 s in mentionCatalog for active error-free stream catch-ups while failing immediately on transport errors, fall back to live meta Flock session rows before catalog flush, and ignore code blocks/spans and numeric dollar prose during skill expansion. Dependencies, contract and licenses are unchanged.

conversationShareMessages.note: Structured conversation share-card turns (`conversationShareMessages`) with decoded mentions/quotes, model name, token estimate and session metadata for native Share as image. Mirrored verbatim from the iOS runtime source in the same change; dependencies and licenses are unchanged.
